# Skich

> Skich is a mobile game discovery platform connecting players with curated collections of new and popular games across iOS and Android.

Skich provides a browsable catalog of 80+ game categories with featured game lists, community connections, and developer resources. The platform supports multiple languages including English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, and Portuguese.

## Key Topics

- Mobile game discovery
- iOS and Android games
- Game recommendations
- Curated game lists
- Open-world games
- FPS and PvP games
- Offline games
- Racing games
- Early access games
- Game genres
- New games 2025
- Gaming community
- Game reviews
- Sandbox games
- Sports games

## Core Discovery

- [Skich Homepage](https://skich.app): Discover mobile games, connect with friends and influencers on Skich
- [Games Catalog](https://skich.app/games): Browsable catalog of 80+ game categories for iOS and Android discovery
- [Featured Gamelists](https://skich.app/gamelists): Curated game collections and featured lists across multiple genres

## Popular Game Collections

- [Best New Games 2025](https://skich.app/gamelists/best-new-mobile-games-2025): Curated list of 40 best new mobile games released in 2025
- [Best FPS & PvP Games](https://skich.app/gamelists/online-fps-highlights): 44 best FPS, PvP, battle royale and arena games for mobile
- [Best Open World Games](https://skich.app/gamelists/top-10-best-open-world-games): Top 10 open-world adventure games for iOS and Android
- [Open World Games like GTA 5 RP](https://skich.app/gamelists/best-open-world-games-like-gta-5-rp): 7 open-world games similar to GTA 5 RP for mobile
- [Best Racing Games](https://skich.app/gamelists/top-10-best-open-world-racing-games-androidios): Top 10 open-world racing and driving games for mobile platforms
- [Top Sports Games 2025](https://skich.app/gamelists/top-10-best-sport-games-2025): Top 10 sports games for 2025 including basketball, soccer, cricket
- [Free Offline Games](https://skich.app/gamelists/best-free-offline-mobile-games): 14 free offline mobile games playable without WiFi connection
- [Sandbox & Physics Games](https://skich.app/gamelists/sandboxels): 10 sandbox and physics-based simulation games for mobile
- [Early Access Games](https://skich.app/gamelists/early-access): 22 early-access games available for iOS and Android platforms
